title: NetworkDockResult
description: network.dock-result@1 (the Dock plan 2026-10-30, K-D1): what GET /api/v1/me/dock answers on OpenVibe.Network — the person's Dock state, the counts the pill's status dot is drawn from, and whether those counts are complete.

state.description: The person's Dock state: the stored one, or the default when they have never opened the Dock.

running.description: How many of the person's agents are running.

unread.description: How many notifications the person has not read.

sources_partial.description: True when an authority behind the counts did not answer, so the counts are lower than the truth.
